question: Find the volume of the largest possible sphere circumscribed by a cube of edge 7 cm
solution:
**Given:**

Edge of the cube = 7 cm

**Concept used:**

The edge of the cube is the diameter of the sphere

**Formula used:**

The volume of a sphere = 4/3 × π × radius³

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e89894632061dd39153fa4db7701490a30cc766512a44a3b584dc2a0d043eb67.png] 

The radius will be 7 / 2 = 3.5 cm

The volume will be,

⇒ 4/3 × 22/7 × 3.5 × 3.5 × 3.5 = 179.67 cm3

**∴ The correct option is 1**
